title: Should maps be kept for areas with no signal?

revisit.trigger: when the first user asks for it

context: Many trails have no phone signal. The map could be downloaded ahead of time for the area around a planned route.

options.name: Download the route's area
options.summary: Keep map tiles for a band around each saved route.

options.name: Online only
options.summary: Leave it to the phone's own map app.

recommendation: Vector tiles (0001) keep the download small.
